options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: backend_type
options.description: * FIRST_GEN: First Generation instance. MySQL only. * SECOND_GEN: Second Generation instance or PostgreSQL instance. * EXTERNAL: A database server that is not managed by Google. Some valid choices include: "FIRST_GEN", "SECOND_GEN", "EXTERNAL"

options.name: connection_name
options.description: Connection name of the Cloud SQL instance used in connection strings.

options.name: database_version
options.description: The database engine type and version. For First Generation instances, can be MYSQL_5_5, or MYSQL_5_6. For Second Generation instances, can be MYSQL_5_6 or MYSQL_5_7. Defaults to MYSQL_5_6. PostgreSQL instances: POSTGRES_9_6 The databaseVersion property can not be changed after instance creation. Some valid choices include: "MYSQL_5_5", "MYSQL_5_6", "MYSQL_5_7", "POSTGRES_9_6"

options.name: disk_encryption_configuration
options.description: Disk encryption settings.

options.name: disk_encryption_status
options.description: Disk encryption status.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: failover_replica
options.description: The name and status of the failover replica. This property is applicable only to Second Generation instances.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: The instance type. This can be one of the following. * CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE: A Cloud SQL instance that is not replicating from a master. * ON_PREMISES_INSTANCE: An instance running on the customer's premises. * READ_REPLICA_INSTANCE: A Cloud SQL instance configured as a read-replica. Some valid choices include: "CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE", "ON_PREMISES_INSTANCE", "READ_REPLICA_INSTANCE"

options.name: ipv6_address
options.description: The IPv6 address assigned to the instance. This property is applicable only to First Generation instances.

options.name: master_instance_name
options.description: The name of the instance which will act as master in the replication setup.

options.name: max_disk_size
options.description: The maximum disk size of the instance in bytes.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Cloud SQL instance. This does not include the project ID.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: region
options.description: The geographical region. Defaults to us-central or us-central1 depending on the instance type (First Generation or Second Generation/PostgreSQL).

options.name: replica_configuration
options.description: Configuration specific to failover replicas and read replicas.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: settings
options.description: The user settings.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP
